% =============================================================
% config.tex — optional user configuration for the resume class.
%
% Copy this file to `config.tex` (next to your resume .tex source)
% and uncomment any line you want to override. With no config.tex
% present, the class defaults apply.
%
% Two ways to populate it:
%   1. Hand-edit (Overleaf, or any LaTeX-only workflow).
%   2. Let scripts/write_config.py regenerate from options.yml.
%
% NOTE for the Python pipeline: if the first line of a generated
% config.tex starts with `% AUTO-GENERATED`, the script will
% overwrite it; otherwise it skips, preserving your hand-edits.
% =============================================================

% --- Accent colour (sections, links, labels, bullets) -----
% Default: black. Provide an RGB triple (0–255 each) or a hex string.
% \definecolor{resumeAccent}{RGB}{15,55,120}
% \definecolor{resumeAccent}{HTML}{0F3778}

% --- Spacing density -------------------------------------
% Controls how tight the vertical rhythm is between bullets,
% sub-headings, and lists. Tune to balance content vs. one-page fit.
% Values: compact | normal | spacious   (default: normal)
% \setSpacingDensity{normal}

% --- Base body font --------------------------------------
% Switches the body face. Math stays on Latin Modern in all cases.
% Values: sourcesans | firasans | latinmodern   (default: sourcesans)
% \setBaseFont{sourcesans}

% --- Language --------------------------------------------
% Affects babel hyphenation and localised labels (e.g.,
% \resumeEducationNote prints "Projet fin de cursus :" in fr,
% "Capstone project:" in en).
% Values: fr | en   (default: en)
% Also settable via class option: \documentclass[fr]{resume}
% \setLanguage{fr}
